title: oenothera hybrida var. ambigua
intro: Oenothera hybrida var. ambigua, commonly known as Evening Primrose, is a perennial plant species native to North America. It is valued for its medicinal properties and edible flowers, seeds, and leaves. The plant is known to possess various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its high levels of omega-6 fatty acids. The bioactive constituents of Evening Primrose include gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), which is believed to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiproliferative effects.
